title: Value of the counter update
statement: Let $r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $c<r+2$ satisfy $c\le r$, and let $b$ be a Boolean. Increasing $c$ by one when $b$ is true and leaving it unchanged when $b$ is false gives the value $c+1$ if $b$ is true and $c$ if $b$ is false.
